name: autockpt_reads
_comment: What does auto-checkpoint do to READS?  The first campaign answered this
only for a 95/5 mix, where both engines lost throughput -- stock more than
BF (-15% vs -10%), which suggests the cost is checkpoint I/O competing with
reads rather than anything BF does wrong.  This isolates the axis:
pure_read       read=100: nothing is ever written, so there is nothing to
checkpoint and the setting should not matter at all.  If it
does, something is wrong beyond I/O contention.
read_mostly     read=95,insert=5 on the 6.8 GB db: the case that lost 10%.
read_warm       read=100 on a db that fits: isolates CPU-side effects from
